name: Tata Capital Ltd.
business_summary: Tata Sons' diversified financial arm (85.41% promoter), listed October 2025 at Rs326. Loan book above Rs3 trillion, AUM +26% y/y: consumer finance (personal, two-wheeler, cars), commercial vehicles/equipment, housing/LAP, SME and corporate, plus wealth/distribution. Q2 FY27 net profit +51% (Rs1,660cr per Business Standard; screener Rs1,832cr). Management says margins recover from Q4 after funding-cost pressure; RBI revolving-credit curbs affect 3-4% of AUM. Tata Sons, an RBI-designated upper-layer NBFC, was told on 2026-09-12 to list; a Tata Sons OFS in Tata Capital remains a possibility. Stock Rs346, P/E 24.5x, P/B 3.0x, flat since IPO.

revenue_mix.segment: commercial vehicles, equipment, SME and corporate

exposures.mechanism: Borrowings ~Rs2.4 lakh cr (Q2 interest Rs4,680cr x4 / ~7.7%); ~55% bank/floating = Rs1.3 lakh cr x 25bp = Rs330cr/yr vs PBT ~Rs10,100cr (financing profit Rs2,532cr x4) = -3.3%; ~half re-prices through floating assets (LAP, corporate, EBLR retail) => -1.6%; persistence 0.5 => -0.8; P/E 24.5x multiple effect => ~-3. Management itself says margin recovery only from Q4.
